content: For intermittently-connected/constrained IoT devices, device-initiated pull/polling (device wakes on a WiFi-connect event or timer, calls a REST endpoint with a bearer/JWT device token) is the standard pattern versus push (MQTT/cloud-to-device), because it avoids holding an open connection, needs no inbound firewall/NAT traversal, and fits low-power duty-cycled hardware; device tokens are typically short bearer tokens rather than full OAuth for constrained clients.
